name: teaching
description: Write and design teaching material that explains: lecture slides, notes pages, puzzles, hint ladders, explorables and their visual design.

interface.shortDescription: Write and design lecture material that explains, not just states.
interface.longDescription: Two skills: teaching-writing for the prose (picture first, every step, a number and its meaning), teaching-design for the visual and interaction design (text roles, colour, reveal, puzzles, gates and explorables), each grounded in multimedia-learning evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use Teaching to revise these lecture slides.
Use Teaching to review this deck's visual design and puzzles.
